verdict: Original integrated snapshot: NO-GO until the two progress-credit defects below are repaired and pure boundary tests pass. No additional env integration blocker found.

findings.issue: Pre-request unloaded count/upward flag/run maximum carry into request-time certification, allowing pre-request clearance to earn progress.
findings.pure_reproducer: s=200,h=.020; ticks 0..198 loaded; 199 unloaded with g=.025, COMvz=.1; 200 unloaded with g=.003, COMvz=-.1. Original source certifies at 200 and credits earlier net gap .024, setting p=1 despite no post-request 20 ms qualified run.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep award-eligible run state confined to the request bonus window; pre-request count, onset and gap maximum must not qualify or be credited.

findings.issue: After flight_seen becomes true, a loaded break does not revoke clearance-credit eligibility. One later unloaded interval can fill p even with downward COM motion.
findings.pure_reproducer: s=200,h=.020; ticks 0..199 loaded; 200/201 unloaded with g=.006, COMvz=.1 gives p=.25; 202 loaded; 203 unloaded with g=.031, COMvz=-.1. Original source immediately sets p=1 from the single unqualified rebound interval.
findings.minimal_fix: Separate historical flight_seen from the currently certified credit-bearing run. A loaded break ends that run; do not grant repeat/rebound clearance credit under this fixed contract.

checked_paths.whole_com: env:343-362 mass-weights synchronized measurement_data.xipos and uses mj_jacSubtreeCom on that same synchronized data/qvel, after checking whole robot is the base subtree. No base-origin substitution or historical force solve found.
checked_paths.terminal_actor_state: env:480-504 uses before_context+progress_before for last_executable_decision and next context+progress_after otherwise; endpoint reward metrics remain distinct from cached actor state.
checked_paths.friction_reset: env:415-419 sets fixed per-episode friction range; parent _configure_dynamics calls plant.set_domain, which restores nominal geom_friction then multiplies the requested scale. No compounding or rejected .95/1.05 override found.
checked_paths.reward_limits: Named progress/flight/landing weights remain 2/1/2 with actual-dt parent terms and fixed height mask. The two credit defects can nevertheless satisfy landing full_progress incorrectly; numerical bonus bounds alone do not prevent this.
